english_description: A year and month pair whose day query returns that Gregorian month's final day.

queries.english: Whether the stored year and month are both valid.
The final day number for the stored month and year.

constraints.english: For a valid month, day() equals the Gregorian month length and February has 29 days exactly in leap years.
ok() is true exactly when the stored year and month each satisfy their own validity predicate.

adversary_table.scenario: February in a non-leap century year returns day twenty-nine.
adversary_table.resolution: Return twenty-eight for February 1900 and other non-leap century years.

adversary_table.scenario: An invalid year or month is reported as a valid year-month pair.
adversary_table.resolution: Return false when either component fails its validity predicate.

source_references.notes: Pinned year_month_day_last data model, month-length table, leap-year branch, and ok(); the accepted contract and examples are recorded in E-5 and E-12.
Creusot contracts for YearMonthDayLast::day and YearMonthDayLast::ok.
